title: 1947. Calculator Using Method Overloading

Calculator Using Method Overloading
10
Easy
Problem Statement
Write a program to demonstrate method overloading by performing different addition operations.
Description
Create a class named Calculator that contains the following overloaded methods:
add(int a, int b) – Adds two integers.
add(int a, int b, int c) – Adds three integers.
add(double a, double b) – Adds two double values.
Read the required inputs and display the results of all three methods.
Sample Input
10
20
30
5.5
4.5
Sample Output
Addition of Two Integers: 30
Addition of Three Integers: 60
Addition of Two Doubles: 10.0
